description: Read DOCX main-document sections in document order. Returns zero-based session-relative section_index values, paragraph/body boundary metadata, page numbering, page size, margins, and header/footer relationship references. Call again after any operation that changes section topology. Read-only.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

google_doc_id.description: Google Doc ID or URL (alternative to file_path). Extract from URL: docs.google.com/document/d/{ID}/edit

name: get_sections
